mastery_sense.description: Mastery is operationalised as agreement with the analyst column on the pulmonary edema benchmark (v0.2, n=30, m=1 placeholder pending recruit). The v0.14.0 Phase 1 R22 captures supplement the v0.10.0 cross-family agreement evidence with within-day reliability evidence.

scope.justification: The pulmonology benchmark is still scoped narrowly (n=30, m=1 placeholder); the v0.14.0 R22 retrofit demonstrates the within-day reliability discipline at the items_in_benchmark scope. Broader-scope claims await an independent clinician panel.

constitution.justification: Agreement on the pulmonology cells is evidence bearing on a mastery attribution (Allen 2026, Remark 8), not a measurement of mastery.

identity_criterion.unverifiable_caveats: Provider APIs (Anthropic, OpenAI, OpenRouter) do not expose model-version snapshots for the providers used here; cross_update_identity_asserted is recorded on faith. The 1h elapsed window between baseline and capture-2 is short enough that across-update model swaps would be exceptional on these providers, but the framework cannot mechanically verify the absence of one.
identity_criterion.rationale: All three captures of each cell run within the same Python orchestrator invocation against the same provider+model_id, with identical EndorsementConfig (defeasible-clinical-v1 prompt embedded in the benchmark, n_samples=3, temperature=0.0, max_tokens=2048) and ProviderParams. The 1h elapsed window between baseline and capture-2 captures the short-horizon across-update drift component of R22; longer intervals will ship as Phase 2 commits via `infereval retest --auto --append-to`.
